independent_formula_scope: Candidate-row raw/per-char choices, normalized choiceCE, true-answer tokenNLL, all predeclared contrasts and paired subject/within-subject intervals recomputed independently from raw.
first_answer_vocabulary_KL_scope: Full-vocabulary KL computed by frozen e163_metrics on GPU (FP32 product, FP64 sum). Raw stores the scalar, not full vocabulary distributions. NumPy verifier checks its aggregation/CI; old all-question E156 scalar guards validate exact reuse. It does not independently recompute vocabulary KL for new conditions.
model_interface_scope: Actual canonical hashes/calibration, old predictions, routing diagonals, causal prefixes/counts/permutations and first-layer identity are GPU controls, not independent initialization repeats.
source_terminal_scope: Only successful worker terminal parameter/buffer/hook checks count as observed; partial outputs cannot imply completion.
evidence_grade: No automatic L3 upgrade from formula or interface checks.
